set.body:
Outcome: commit requested-output foundation, then provide bounded NIfTI ingress, persistent prepared subject sessions, explicit invalidation, a cohort scheduler and an executable 25-subject cold/design-edit/contrast-edit qualification to identified group-ready outputs.
Scope: fmridataset owns file ingress and volume geometry; fmrimod owns immutable data sessions, model/noise lifecycle and cohort scheduling. Existing regression and group reducers remain providers. No preprocessing, registration, real subject data, publication, silent IID fallback or arbitrary new projection solver.
Invariants: explicit data f64 conversion/scaling, exact x-fastest spatial identity and row IDs, fixed-vs-estimated noise policies, bounded resident and working bytes; checked memory before numerical reads; subject workers use one block worker each. A design change cannot reuse data-dependent noise without an explicit conditional/fixed-noise decision. Contrast-only changes reuse factorization/noise and resident data. Projection caching only after measured justification and separate numerical qualification.
Implementation: additive typed NIfTI source/reader, leaving existing SourceSpec memory API intact; immutable loaded subject with data and semantic geometry; explicit model preparation and fit sessions; bounded ordered cohort work with streaming callbacks; synthetic on-disk fixtures and group-map export/example. Standard nifti crate for validated header/stream decoding, not an ad hoc binary parser.
Acceptance: independent NIfTI value/geometry/scaling fixture checks, gzip/uncompressed parity, truncation/budget/order/invalid header errors; fresh model equality after design edits and no stale estimated AR reuse; cold vs warm counts and timings for 25 subjects; scoped tests/clippy/fmt and evidence/source hashes. Existing disk rule requires >=20GB before full builds; reclaim only idle prior thread-owned Cargo caches.
Next action: scope commit of existing output files, establish NIfTI reader contract, implement subject lifecycle and scheduler with focused tests.
set.title: Persistent NIfTI subject sessions and bounded cohort execution
